sql_templates.query: WITH recent_flows AS ( SELECT trade_date, SUM(fii_net_today) AS fii_sum, SUM(dii_net_today) AS dii_sum FROM signals.fii_dii_flows WHERE trade_date > CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '3 months' GROUP BY trade_date ), recent_regime AS ( SELECT trade_date, regime FROM signals.regime_history WHERE trade_date > CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '3 months' ), recent_breadth AS ( SELECT trade_date, ad_signal FROM breadth.market_daily WHERE trade_date > CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '3 months' ), recent_index AS ( SELECT trade_date, index_symbol, close FROM market.index_eod WHERE trade_date > CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '3 months' AND index_symbol = 'Nifty 500' ) SELECT rf.trade_date, rf.fii_sum, rf.dii_sum, rr.regime, rb.ad_signal, ri.close FROM recent_flows rf INNER JOIN recent_regime rr ON rf.trade_date = rr.trade_date INNER JOIN recent_breadth rb ON rf.trade_date = rb.trade_date INNER JOIN recent_index ri ON rf.trade_date = ri.trade_date ORDER BY rf.trade_date DESC LIMIT 100;

sql_templates.description: Identify improving sectors by measuring change in breadth and Stage 2 participation.
sql_templates.sql:
WITH latest_snapshots AS (SELECT * FROM breadth.sector_daily WHERE snapshot_date = (SELECT MAX(snapshot_date) FROM breadth.sector_daily)), 
latest_ma AS (SELECT * FROM breadth.ma_pct_above WHERE snapshot_date = (SELECT MAX(snapshot_date) FROM breadth.ma_pct_above)), 
latest_stages AS (SELECT * FROM scores.stage_snapshots WHERE snapshot_date = (SELECT MAX(snapshot_date) FROM scores.stage_snapshots)) 
SELECT sd.sector, sd.breadth_signal, ma.stage2_pct 
FROM latest_snapshots sd 
JOIN latest_ma ma ON sd.snapshot_date = ma.snapshot_date 
WHERE sd.breadth_signal = 'positive' 
AND ma.stage2_pct > 20;
